title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij.2.4: confessions_post not refactored to use coap_oscore_auth_mutating
description:
confessions_post in coap_dtn.c still duplicates the full OSCORE unprotect logic inline (lines 240-283), while deaddrop_post and msg_inbox_post were refactored to use the new coap_oscore_auth_mutating helper. This means confessions_post has its own stack-allocated plain buffer (64 bytes, line 266) with the same use-after-free pattern, and it uses a different error-return convention (direct positive code) than the refactored handlers (double-negated).

Location: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_dtn.c:240-283 and coap_oscore.c:249 (the refactored helper).
